nina_marketing: Quick: craft a 1-page exec playbook for the webinar follow-up targeted at security/compliance and infra teams. Needs: scannable deploy-mode matrix, SLA highlights, short benchmark callout (provisional), 2 AE-ready email snippets, and routing tags.
sam_sales: AEs want 15s and 30s talking tracks plus a one-paragraph tech blurb they can paste. Also need SFDC tag and lead priority.
jordan_product: I'll sketch layout: TLDR (1 line), Deploy matrix (Hosted / Dedicated / Private, pros), SLA box, Security controls, Benchmark callout, AE snippets, Routing + gating.
lee_field: Add 3 copy-paste objection responses: data residency, SLA proof, incident playbooks. Keep them one-liners.
maya_growth: Tracking: utm_campaign=infops_playbook, utm_content=exec_brief_v1, lead_tag=enterprise_infops. Add experiment id placeholder for headline tests.
ops-bot: Note: mark benchmark numbers as provisional and include measurement note.
jordan_product: Micro copy (first pass):

"Redwood Exec Playbook: Enterprise Inference Ops
Run inference with controls you can audit and SLAs you can promise. One API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments so engineering work stays minimal while governance is preserved."

Deploy matrix (one line each):
- Hosted: Quick trial and scale; managed models and fast onboarding.
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools, consistent throughput, SLA-backed support.
- Private: VPC/on-prem with KMS/HSM, immutable audit logs, and air-gap options.

SLA snapshot: Optional enterprise SLA (up to 99.95%), P95 latency targets by model tier, 4-hour incident acknowledgement and 24x7 escalation for enterprise customers.

Security controls: Customer-owned KMS via KMS/HSM, VPC/private link, RBAC, immutable audit logs, SOC2-aligned controls.

Benchmark (provisional callout): P95 ~82ms; 135 req/s on 8x-GPU pool; token unit cost ~0.56x vs baseline. Measurement note: internal tuning run; customers should validate via dedicated trial.

AE snippets (paste-ready):
- 15s: "Redwood delivers audited, SLA-backed inference across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments so your security and infra teams keep control without engineering rewrites."
- 30s: "We provide a single API that runs the same way in Hosted, Dedicated, and Private modes. That means you can adopt reserved or private capacity without changing clients, retain KMS/HSM control of keys, capture immutable audit trails, and meet P95 latency SLOs through our runtime optimizations."

Email templates:
- Short subject: "Secure inference + SLAs - one-page brief"
- Short body: "Hi <Name>, attaching a one-page playbook that summarizes deploy options, SLA guarantees, and security controls. Can we schedule 20m to discuss fit?"
- Long body: "Hi <Name>, following up from the webinar Attached is a concise playbook covering Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments, our SLA tiers, key management options (KMS/HSM), and a benchmark snapshot. If helpful, we can schedule a technical sizing session and run a short trial with your workload."

Objection responses (one-liners):
- Data residency: "We support region-specific, VPC, and on-prem deployments; keys remain under customer control."
- SLA proof: "Reserved capacity customers get documented runbooks, SLA terms, and 24x7 escalation."
- Incident playbook: "We provide an incident runbook and can set up post-incident reviews for enterprise customers."

Routing & gating (ops-ready):
- Download -> add tag: enterprise_infops_playbook
- UTMs: utm_campaign=infops_playbook; utm_content=exec_brief_v1
- SFDC: Lead.OwnerQueue=AE_Enterprise_Security; Lead.Priority=High; Lead.Source=webinar_playbook
- Gating form: company, work_email, role, region, estimated_RPS, use_case
- Auto follow-up template id: mk_follow_infops_v1

nina_marketing: Owners & deadlines: jordan_product -> draft v1 (today); sam_sales -> AE polish (tomorrow); maya_growth -> set UTMs and form (tomorrow); lee_field -> objections verification (tomorrow). Final asset live by Thu EOD.

sam_sales: I'll prepare the CSV-friendly SFDC tag mapping and a short discovery checklist for AEs.

ops-bot: Webinar reminder: "Inference Ops: Secure Deploys" scheduled 2026-04-09 11:00 PT. Reminder 72h prior.

nina_marketing: Thanks team. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to close copy and confirm gating. :rocket:
